FINAL SQL:
SELECT city.Name
FROM city
JOIN country ON city.CountryCode = country.Code
WHERE country.Continent = 'Europe'
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM countrylanguage cl
    WHERE cl.CountryCode = country.Code
      AND cl.Language = 'English'
      AND cl.IsOfficial = 'T'
  );
